blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained video editors possess rich removal and completion priors, yet may retain targets or alter unrelated content. We present H3Remover, which reinforces MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA for video object removal without paired object-free training targets. To discourage superficial edits such as recoloring, a target-removal reward favors calibrated depth changes consistent with revealing farther content. To limit unintended scene changes, a background-geometry reward encourages preservation of relative depth ordering. To preserve background appearance without retaining unwanted shadows or reflections, an appearance reward constrains RGB changes in source-derived protected regions while exempting targets and estimated effects. Frozen HPSv3 complements these constraints with perceptual-quality feedback for synthesized content. Evaluation regions remain fixed across candidates, and DiffusionART optimizes LoRA adapters with the backbone frozen. Experiments show substantial reconstruction gains over original H3, with qualitative comparisons demonstrating more effective object removal and better preservation of surrounding scene content.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的视频编辑器有丰富的删除和完成前科,但可能保留目标或改变无关内容。 我们提出H3Remover,它强化了MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA,用于在不配对的无对象训练目标下清除视频物体. 为了劝阻肤浅的编辑, 如重新涂色, 目标删除奖励会有利于校准深度变化, 为了限制意外的场景变化,背景几何奖励鼓励保持相对深度顺序. 为了保持背景外观而不保留不想要的阴影或反射,外观奖励会限制RGB在来源保护区的变化,同时免除目标和估计影响. Frozen HPSv3用对合成内容的感知质量反馈来补充这些制约. 评估区域在候选人之间仍然固定不变,而 " 传播农业资源 " 方案则优化了LORA适配器,使其骨干冻结。 实验显示比原H3有相当大的重建收益,质的比较表明更有效地清除物体,更好地保存周围的场景内容.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video object removal aims to erase unwanted objects and reconstruct the scene behind them while retaining the content that should remain unchanged.
Beyond filling masked pixels, this task requires a careful balance between modifying the target and preserving the surrounding scene.
Flow-guided propagation and spatiotemporal transformers provide effective tools for video inpainting [ 22 , 53 , 57 ] , while diffusion-based approaches introduce generative priors for recovering missing content [ 21 , 1 , 58 ] .
However, the region that needs modification may extend beyond an object’s visible silhouette: shadows, reflections, and other associated effects can remain after the object itself disappears [ 29 , 31 , 7 ] .
A useful removal model must therefore learn both what to change and what to preserve.
blocks.zh:
视频对象移除旨在抹去不想要的物体并重建其后面的场景,同时保留应当保持不变的内容.
除了填充蒙面像素外,这项任务还需要在修改目标和维护周围场景之间保持谨慎的平衡.
流导传播和spatiental变压器为视频涂装提供了有效的工具[22、53、57],而基于传播的方法则引入了回收缺失内容的基因前序[21、1、58]。
然而,需要修改的区域可能超出物体的可见光线:在物体本身消失后,阴影、反射和其他相关效应可以保留[29、31、7]。
因此,一个有用的删除模式必须既了解要改变又了解要保留什么。

blocks.en:
Obtaining paired supervision for this task is challenging: a clean target video must remove both the object and its associated effects while preserving the remaining scene and temporal alignment.
Existing efforts construct such pairs through synthetic rendering or controlled real-world capture [ 31 , 7 ] .
Rendering depends on curated assets and simulated interactions, while real-world capture requires carefully matched scene conditions, lighting, and camera motion.
These requirements make data construction costly and constrain coverage of diverse real-world scenes and effects.
This motivates adapting a capable pretrained editor without requiring paired object-free target videos.
blocks.zh:
为这项任务获得配对监督是一项挑战:一个干净的目标视频必须消除物体及其相关效果,同时保留剩余场景和时间对齐.
现有努力通过合成渲染或控制真实世界捕捉来构建这种配对[31,7].
渲染取决于被整理的资产和模拟的相互作用,而现实世界的捕捉则需要精心匹配的场景条件,照明,以及相机运动.
这些要求使数据构建费用高昂,限制了对各种现实世界场景和影响的覆盖。
这激发了在不需要配对的无对象目标视频的情况下,对有能力的预训编辑器进行改造.

blocks.en:
Pretrained video generators and editors offer a promising foundation for such adaptation through their rich visual and editing priors [ 52 , 16 , 42 , 12 ] . We build on MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA (H3-Base-Ref2VA), the reference-conditioned branch of MiniMax-H3, used here as a video editor. 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 Our starting observation is that the pretrained model already possesses useful priors for object removal, background completion, and associated-effect editing, but does not consistently express these capabilities under removal instructions.
Figure 2 illustrates this gap.
In Fig. 2 (a), original H3 removes both the bicycle and its cast shadow, demonstrating an existing ability to edit beyond the target silhouette.
In contrast, it retains the target in (b), recolors the toy crab instead of removing it in (c), and erases unrelated scene content along with the target in (d).
These contrasting outcomes motivate strengthening removal instruction following and source-scene preservation: a plausible edited video does not necessarily satisfy the requested edit.
blocks.zh:
训练有素的录像机和编辑通过其丰富的视觉和编辑前传[52、16、42、12]为这种改编提供了有希望的基础。 我们以MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA(H3-Base-Ref2VA)为基础,这是MiniMax-H3的参考条件分支,在这里作为视频编辑。 我们的开始观察是,经过预先训练的模型已经具备了有用的前科,用于对象清除,背景完成,以及关联效果编辑,但并没有在清除指令下一致地表达这些能力.
图2说明了这一差距。
在图2(a)中,原H3同时移除了自行车及其投影,显示出了超越目标 silhouette 的现有编辑能力.
与此相反,它保留了(b)中的目标,将玩具蟹重新涂色,而不是去掉(c)中的目标,并将不相关的场景内容与(d)中的目标一起抹去.
这些对比性的结果促使在后面加强删除指示和源景保存:一个可信的编辑视频不一定满足请求的编辑要求。

blocks.en:
We present H3Remover , a reinforcement learning framework that elicits the editor’s removal capabilities while constraining unintended changes.
The desired edit has two coupled requirements: remove the indicated objects and preserve the unrelated scene.
Strict reconstruction outside the target silhouette can preserve unwanted shadows or reflections, whereas rewarding removal alone can tolerate background changes.
General preference models [ 47 , 15 , 26 ] offer quality feedback but do not explicitly encode these source-dependent requirements.
We therefore combine interpretable source-conditioned rewards with auxiliary preference feedback.
Given original and target-highlighted videos and a removal prompt, we optimize LoRA adapters [ 11 ] through DiffusionART [ 43 ] , keeping the backbone frozen and requiring no paired object-free training targets.
blocks.zh:
我们提出H3Remover,这是一个强化的学习框架,它吸引了编辑器的清除能力,同时制约了意想不到的变化。
想要的编辑有两个组合要求:移除指示对象并保存不相关的场景.
在目标外进行严格的重建可以保留不想要的阴影或反射,而光是奖励清除就可以容忍背景变化.
一般偏好模式[47,15,26]提供质量反馈,但没有明确编码这些依赖源的要求.
因此,我们把可解释的有来源条件的奖励与辅助性的偏好反馈结合起来。
鉴于原创性和目标突出的视频和删除提示,我们通过DifmusionART[43]优化了LORA适配器[11],保持骨干冷冻,不需要配对的无对象训练目标.

blocks.en:
Our first two rewards use estimated geometry to distinguish desirable target changes from undesirable background changes.
When an opaque foreground object is removed, the newly revealed surface is typically farther from the camera than the object it replaces.
We use this observation to define a target-removal reward : after calibrating source and edited depth predictions to a comparable scale, we reward target pixels whose estimated depth increases.
This signal serves as a proxy for revealing the scene behind the object, rather than a semantic certificate of successful removal.
To constrain the surrounding scene, a complementary background-geometry reward penalizes changes in the relative depth ordering of background pixel pairs.
Inspired by the use of depth ranking in SparseNeRF [ 44 ] , this term encourages consistent near–far relationships instead of requiring identical absolute depth predictions.
Both rewards use a frozen Video Depth Anything estimator [ 6 ] , encouraging targeted geometric change while constraining the scene outside the target regions.
blocks.zh:
我们的前两个奖项使用估计几何来区分理想的目标变化和不可取的背景变化.
当一个不透明的前景物体被移除时,新揭示的表面一般比它所取代的对象离相机更远.
我们用这个观察来定义目标清除奖励:在将源进行校准并编辑深度预测到可比尺度后,我们奖励估计深度增加的目标像素.
这个信号作为显示物体背后的场景的代名词,而不是成功移除的语义证书.
为了限制周围的场景,一个互补的背景几何奖励会惩罚背景像素对像素对像的相对深度顺序的变化.
在SparseNERF [44] 中使用深度排名的启发下,这个术语鼓励近-远关系保持一致,而不是要求相同的绝对深度预测.
两个奖项都使用一个冷冻的Video Deph Anything 估测器[6],鼓励目标几何变化,同时限制目标区域以外的场景.

blocks.en:
Our third reward protects appearance while allowing object-associated effects to change.
We threshold a source-derived blending map from frozen OSOR [ 56 ] into a binary protection mask.
The appearance reward penalizes RGB deviations from the original video only in protected regions, exempting targets and estimated effects.
OSOR’s synthesized RGB is never a reconstruction target.
Masks and protection regions are fixed before candidate generation, ensuring that candidates share the same spatial reference.
Frozen HPSv3 [ 30 ] provides complementary visual-quality feedback that encourages plausible reconstruction in regions exposed by object removal, helping reduce black-filled patches and translucent residual artifacts like previous methods.
blocks.zh:
我们的第三个奖赏保护外观,同时允许与对象相关的效果改变.
我们把一张来源生成的混合地图 从冻结的OSOR [56] 进入二进制保护面具。
外观奖励惩罚RGB仅在保护区偏离原视频,免除目标和估计效果.
OSOR合成的RGB从来不是重建目标.
面具和保护区域在候选人生成之前是固定的,确保候选人共享相同的空间参考.
冻结的HPSv3[30]提供了补充的视觉质量反馈,鼓励在被清除物体所暴露的区域进行可信的重建,帮助减少黑填补丁和像以前的方法那样的半透明残余文物.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold: • Reinforcement of pretrained removal capabilities. We introduce H3Remover, which adapts H3-Base-Ref2VA toward faithful removal instruction following through source-conditioned rewards.
The framework builds on editing priors and uses DiffusionART-based LoRA optimization without paired object-free target videos during adaptation. • Complementary geometry-based rewards. We couple a calibrated target-depth change reward with a background depth-order preservation reward, providing separate feedback for changing the target region and retaining the surrounding scene structure. • Effect-aware appearance preservation. We formulate a source-referenced RGB preservation reward with a fixed binary protection mask, allowing changes in estimated effect regions while penalizing unnecessary appearance changes elsewhere.
Auxiliary preference feedback complements these explicit constraints to guide visual quality.
blocks.zh:
• 加强经过预先训练的清除能力。 我们引入了H3Remover,它使H3-Base-Ref2VA适应通过源头条件的奖励来完成忠实的清除教育.
该框架建立在编辑前科的基础上,并在适应期间使用基于DifunusulationART的LORA优化,不配对无对象目标视频. • 以几何学为基础的补充奖励。 我们把目标深度调整奖励与背景深度排序保护奖励结合起来,为改变目标区域提供单独的反馈,并保留周围的场景结构。 • 保持对效果的认识。 我们用固定的二进制保护面具制定来源参考的RGB保护奖励,允许估计效果区域的变化,同时惩罚其他地方不必要的外观变化.
辅助偏好反馈补充了这些明确的制约因素,以指导视觉质量.

blocks.en:
Reinforcement of pretrained removal capabilities. We introduce H3Remover, which adapts H3-Base-Ref2VA toward faithful removal instruction following through source-conditioned rewards.
The framework builds on editing priors and uses DiffusionART-based LoRA optimization without paired object-free target videos during adaptation.
blocks.zh:
加强预训清除能力. 我们引入了H3Remover,它使H3-Base-Ref2VA适应通过源头条件的奖励来完成忠实的清除教育.
该框架建立在编辑前科的基础上,并在适应期间使用基于DifunusulationART的LORA优化,不配对无对象目标视频.

blocks.en: Complementary geometry-based rewards. We couple a calibrated target-depth change reward with a background depth-order preservation reward, providing separate feedback for changing the target region and retaining the surrounding scene structure.
blocks.zh: 补充几何学奖励. 我们把目标深度调整奖励与背景深度排序保护奖励结合起来,为改变目标区域提供单独的反馈,并保留周围的场景结构。

blocks.en:
Effect-aware appearance preservation. We formulate a source-referenced RGB preservation reward with a fixed binary protection mask, allowing changes in estimated effect regions while penalizing unnecessary appearance changes elsewhere.
Auxiliary preference feedback complements these explicit constraints to guide visual quality.
blocks.zh:
注意效果的外观 我们用固定的二进制保护面具制定来源参考的RGB保护奖励,允许估计效果区域的变化,同时惩罚其他地方不必要的外观变化.
辅助偏好反馈补充了这些明确的制约因素,以指导视觉质量.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion models [ 10 , 39 ] , latent diffusion [ 37 ] , and diffusion transformers [ 34 ] support scalable visual generation.
CogVideoX [ 52 ] , HunyuanVideo [ 16 ] , Wan [ 42 ] , and VACE [ 12 ] extend generative priors and conditioning mechanisms to video.
Following image editing approaches such as Prompt-to-Prompt [ 9 ] and InstructPix2Pix [ 3 ] , video editors address correspondence through adaptation [ 46 ] , cross-frame attention [ 14 ] , attention control [ 36 , 28 ] , and feature propagation [ 8 ] .
Pix2Video [ 5 ] , Rerender A Video [ 51 ] , and AnyV2V [ 17 ] transfer image-level edits to video; CoDeF [ 33 ] separates canonical content and temporal deformation.
H3Remover studies task-specific adaptation feedback for an existing video editor.
blocks.zh:
扩散模型[10,39],潜在扩散[37],扩散变压器[34]支持可伸缩的视觉生成.
CogVideoX [52],HunyuanVideo [16],Wan [42],和VACE [12]将基因前科和调节机制扩展到视频.
采用图像编辑方法,如“快速到快速”[9]和“指示Pix2Pix[3]”,视频编辑通过改编[46]、跨框架注意[14]、注意力控制[36、28]和特性传播[8]处理通信。
Pix2Video [5],将A Video [51],AnyV2V [17] 将图像级编辑转移到视频; CoDeF [33] 分离了犬科的内容和时间变形.
H3Remover为现有的视频编辑器研究特定任务适应反馈.

blocks.en:
Video inpainting uses transformer fusion [ 27 ] , flow-guided synthesis [ 22 , 53 ] , and dual-domain propagation [ 57 ] .
DiffuEraser [ 21 ] , VideoPainter [ 1 ] , and MiniMax-Remover [ 58 ] exploit diffusion priors for completion and removal.
Omnimatte [ 29 ] , OmnimatteRF [ 24 ] , Generative Omnimatte [ 19 ] , and OmnimatteZero [ 38 ] associate objects with their effects through decomposition and generative priors.
ROSE [ 31 ] , EffectErase [ 7 ] , Object-WIPER [ 18 ] , EffectLearner [ 45 ] , and VOID [ 32 ] address removal with associated effects or interactions.
Image methods include ObjectClear [ 54 ] and OSOR [ 56 ] .
Our focus is adapting an editor using source-referenced rewards.
We reuse OSOR to locate regions where appearance preservation should be relaxed; its output is neither a clean RGB target nor an effect-removal success score.
Thus, effect localization is supplied by an expert, while our design specifies how it enters the adaptation objective.
blocks.zh:
视频涂装使用变压器聚变[27],流导合成[22,53],双域传播[57].
DiffuEraser [21],VideoPainter [1],和MiniMax-Remover [58] 利用扩散前科完成并移除.
Omnimatte [29], OmnimatteRF [24], Generative Omnimatte [19], OmnimatteZero [38] 通过分解和基因前科将物体与其效应联系起来.
ROSE [31],EffectErase [7],Object-WIPER [18],EffectLearner [45],VOID [32] 处理带相关效应或相互作用的去除.
图像方法包括ObjectClear [54] 和 OSOR [56].
我们的焦点是调整一个编辑 利用源源的奖励。
我们重新使用OSOR来定位应当放松外观保存的区域;其输出既不是一个干净的RGB目标,也不是效果清除成功得分.
因此,本地化的效果是由一位专家提供的,而我们的设计则规定了如何进入适应目标。

blocks.en:
Depth Anything [ 49 ] , Depth Anything V2 [ 50 ] , Marigold [ 13 ] , and Video Depth Anything [ 6 ] provide depth priors.
SparseNeRF [ 44 ] uses depth ranking in novel-view synthesis; we use ordering to compare a source video with its edited counterpart.
DDPO [ 2 ] , AlignProp [ 35 ] , and Diffusion-DPO [ 41 ] study reward or preference optimization.
ImageReward [ 47 ] , PickScore [ 15 ] , VideoReward [ 26 ] , and HPSv3 [ 30 ] supply quality or preference signals.
Flow-GRPO [ 25 ] , DanceGRPO [ 48 ] , DiffusionNFT [ 55 ] , and DiffusionART [ 43 ] develop generative-model optimization strategies.
We use DiffusionART with LoRA [ 11 ] to optimize the editor with these task-specific signals.
Our focus is the regional reward construction: encourage target change, constrain background ordering, and protect appearance outside estimated effect regions.
Frozen HPSv3 complements these regional rewards with visual-quality feedback.
blocks.zh:
深度 Anything [49],深度 Anything V2 [50],Marigold [13],和视频深度 Anything [6]提供深度前传.
SparseNERF [44] 在小说-视图合成中采用深度排名;我们使用命令来比较一个源视频与它的编辑对应.
DDPO [2], AlignProp [35], 和扩散-DPO [41] 研究奖励或优惠优化.
Image Reward [47], PickScore [15], VideoReward [26],和HPSv3 [30] 提供质量或偏好信号.
Flow-GRPO [25],DanceGRPO [48],DivusulationNFT [55],以及DivusulationART [43] 开发基因模型优化策略.
我们使用DiffusulationART与Lora [11] 优化编辑器,以这些任务特定的信号.
我们的重点是区域奖励建设:鼓励改变目标,限制背景订单,保护在估计效果区域以外的外观。
冻结的HPSv3用视觉质量反馈来补充这些区域奖励.

blocks.en: 3 H3Remover
blocks.zh: 3辆H3轮驱动车

blocks.en:
H3Remover adapts a pretrained H3-Base-Ref2VA editor using source-referenced rewards rather than paired object-free targets (Fig. 3 ).
The design separates the desired target change from constraints on the surrounding scene; all auxiliary estimators and the backbone remain frozen.
blocks.zh:
H3Remover使用源参考奖而不是配对的无对象目标(图3)来调整一个预训的H3-Base-Ref2VA编辑器.
设计将所期望的目标改变与周围场景的限制区分开来;所有辅助估计器和骨干仍然被冻结.

blocks.en: 3.1 Source-Conditioned Editing
blocks.zh: 3.1 源码编辑

blocks.en:
Let 𝐗 = { 𝐗 t } t = 1 N \mathbf{X}=\{\mathbf{X}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{N} denote a source video with RGB values in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ,
and let 𝐘 \mathbf{Y} denote a candidate edit.
For frame t t , ℐ t \mathcal{I}_{t} indexes visible target instances, Ω t j \Omega_{t}^{j} is the pixel support of instance j j ,
and 𝐌 t \mathbf{M}_{t} is their binary union mask.
The editor receives the original video,
a synchronized copy with translucent target masks
and white contours, and a removal instruction.
The annotated copy identifies targets; the original supplies unobscured appearance.
The prompt requests removal of targets and associated effects while preserving unrelated content and camera motion.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.2 Geometry-Based Rewards

blocks.en:
An RGB change inside a target mask can indicate recoloring
rather than deletion.
We instead exploit the expectation that removing an occluding
foreground object reveals farther content.
A frozen Video Depth Anything estimator [ 6 ] predicts source and edited inverse depths, 𝐃 t x \mathbf{D}_{t}^{\mathrm{x}} and 𝐃 t y \mathbf{D}_{t}^{\mathrm{y}} ,
with larger values indicating nearer surfaces.
Because independent predictions can differ in scale and shift,
we robustly fit one positive affine mapping over the clip, 𝐃 ^ t y = a ​ 𝐃 t y + b ​ 𝟏 \widehat{\mathbf{D}}_{t}^{\mathrm{y}}=a\mathbf{D}_{t}^{\mathrm{y}}+b\mathbf{1} ,
using background anchors outside source target bounding boxes.
Disjoint anchor subsets provide fitting and residual estimation.
Calibration assumes enough comparable background anchors remain;
it uses depth alone, without RGB filtering or spatial alignment.
Defining δ t ​ ( 𝐮 ) = D t x ​ ( 𝐮 ) − D ^ t y ​ ( 𝐮 ) \delta_{t}(\mathbf{u})=D_{t}^{\mathrm{x}}(\mathbf{u})-\widehat{D}_{t}^{\mathrm{y}}(\mathbf{u}) ,

a sufficiently large decrease in inverse depth: r t rem = 1 | ℐ t | ∑ j ∈ ℐ t 1 | Ω t j | ∑ 𝐮 ∈ Ω t j 𝕀 [ δ t ( 𝐮 ) > τ ] . r_{t}^{\mathrm{rem}}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{I}_{t}|}\sum_{j\in\mathcal{I}_{t}}\frac{1}{|\Omega_{t}^{j}|}\sum_{\mathbf{u}\in\Omega_{t}^{j}}\mathbb{I}[\delta_{t}(\mathbf{u})>\tau]. (1) Here 𝕀 \mathbb{I} is an indicator and τ = max ⁡ ( 0.01 ​ s x , e 95 ) \tau=\max(0.01s_{\mathrm{x}},e_{95}) ,
where s x s_{\mathrm{x}} is the source fitting-anchor 95 95 th– 5 5 th percentile depth span
and e 95 e_{95} is the held-out 95 95 th-percentile
absolute calibration residual.
The threshold discounts depth changes within the calibration residual.
A fraction score limits the benefit of excessive depth change,
and instance averaging prevents large targets from dominating.
This proxy relies on the foreground-occluder assumption rather than testing semantic absence. In many scenes, particularly road scenes, removing foreground vehicles or pedestrians reveals farther surfaces; reinforcement on such cases may also benefit removal in scenes where this depth assumption does not hold through shared editing capabilities.

Inspired by depth-ranking constraints [ 44 ] ,
we instead compare relative ordering at corresponding
background coordinates.
A source-fixed pair set 𝒫 t \mathcal{P}_{t} uses horizontal
and vertical offsets of 1 1 , 8 8 , 32 32 , and 128 128 pixels,
with both endpoints outside 𝐌 t \mathbf{M}_{t} .
For each depth map, o t ​ ( 𝐮 , 𝐯 ) ∈ { − 1 , 0 , + 1 } o_{t}(\mathbf{u},\mathbf{v})\in\{-1,0,+1\} describes near, tied, or far ordering;
differences within 1 % 1\% of that map’s background 95 95 th– 5 5 th percentile span are treated as ties.

(2) Relative thresholds provide invariance to positive affine depth
transformations; ties reduce sensitivity on nearly flat surfaces.
Source-valid pairs with invalid edited depths count
as mismatches rather than disappearing from the denominator.
This discourages changes in background ordering without
aligning away spatial drift.
A separate RGB constraint complements this structural feedback.
3.3 Effect-Aware Appearance Preservation

Within the valid, non-void image region,
we define binary protection as W t ( 𝐮 ) = 𝕀 [ α t ( 𝐮 ) < η ] ( 1 − M t ( 𝐮 ) ) W_{t}(\mathbf{u})=\mathbb{I}[\alpha_{t}(\mathbf{u})<\eta]\bigl(1-M_{t}(\mathbf{u})\bigr) ,

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We adapt H3-Base-Ref2VA on 970 removal tasks: 290 ROSE, 214 Waymo, 214 KITTI-360, 195 MOSE, and 57 DAVIS2017.
Only source videos and target annotations enter adaptation; object-free references are not training targets.
Rank-16 LoRA adapters update attention projections, with the backbone and reward estimators frozen.
AdamW uses a peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , 20 warm-up updates, and cosine decay.
We sample four candidates per condition, reporting the 100-update checkpoint.
Rollouts and evaluation use 10 and 50 sampling points, respectively.
The full model uses weights ( λ rem , λ geo , λ app , λ pref ) = ( 1 , 1 , 5 , 0.05 ) (\lambda_{\mathrm{rem}},\lambda_{\mathrm{geo}},\lambda_{\mathrm{app}},\lambda_{\mathrm{pref}})=(1,1,5,0.05) and protection threshold η = 0.1 \eta=0.1 .

blocks.en:
We evaluate H3Remover on PROVE-M [ 20 ] , WIPER [ 18 ] , KITTI-360 [ 23 ] , and Waymo [ 40 ] .
PROVE-M contains 80 paired tasks with object-free references, enabling reference-based evaluation of removal and scene reconstruction.
WIPER contributes 60 tasks without clean references, complementing the paired evaluation.
KITTI-360 and Waymo each contribute 15 driving clips, covering vehicle and pedestrian removal in road scenes.
The 30 driving clips originate from 10 independent scenes.
For datasets without clean references, we report RC-S, RC-T, and automated target-disappearance judgments.
blocks.zh:
我们评价PROVE-M [20],WIPER [18],KITTI-360 [23],以及Waymo [40]。
PROVE-M包含80个配对任务,无对象引用,使得能对移除和场景重建进行基于参考的评价.
WIPER在不提供干净参考的情况下提供60项任务,补充配对评价.
KITTI-360和Waymo各提供15个驾驶夹,包括路面车辆和行人搬运。
30个驱动片段源于10个独立场景.
对于没有干净参考的数据集,我们报告RC-S、RC-T和自动目标消失判断。

blocks.en:
Methods are evaluated on a shared 124-frame, 24-Hz window and a 544 × 960 544\times 960 canvas; spatial padding and repeated tail frames are excluded.
Baselines retain method-specific inference settings, so our common-window results are not reproductions of their published native-resolution scores.
We report PSNR, SSIM, AlexNet-based LPIPS, RC-S, RC-T, and FVD, using a fixed I3D-based protocol for FVD.
Without clean references, RC-S ( ↑ \uparrow ) measures local feature coherence between restored regions and surrounding background, while RC-T ( ↓ \downarrow ) measures temporal discrepancy in shared restored regions across adjacent frames [ 20 ] .
GPT-6-sol judges target disappearance from up to eight matched frames, with method identities anonymized.
We report S / N S/N , where N = S + F + U N=S+F+U includes success, failure, and unknown judgments.
This automated evaluation checks target disappearance in sampled frames.
blocks.zh:
在共用的124帧、24Hz窗口和544×960 544\times 960帆布上评价方法;不包括空间垫和重复尾框。
基线保留了特定方法的推论设置,因此我们的共同窗口结果不是复制其已公布的本土解析分数.
我们报告PSNR,SSIM,基于AlexNet的LPIPS,RC-S,RC-T,以及FVD,使用基于FVD的固定I3D协议.
没有干净的参考文献,RC-S (\%) 测量恢复区域与周围背景之间的局部一致性,而RC-T (\%\%) 测量邻近框架共享恢复区域的时间差异[20].
GPT-6-Sol评委将目标从最多8个匹配的帧中瞄准消失,方法上的身份匿名.
我们报告S/N S/N,其中N = S + F + U N + F+U 包括成功,失败,以及未知的判断.
这种自动评估检查目标在抽样框架中消失.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与现行方法的比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares H3Remover with ProPainter [ 57 ] , DiffuEraser [ 21 ] , MiniMax-Remover [ 58 ] , ROSE [ 31 ] , and EffectErase [ 7 ] on PROVE-M.
H3Remover leads all six image/video metrics.
Against original H3, PSNR improves by 7.151 dB, LPIPS and FVD decrease by 60.3% and 84.7%, and sampled-frame confirmed removals increase from 40/80 to 73/80.
Against the best baseline per metric, PSNR improves by 1.395 dB, LPIPS decreases by 18.9%, and FVD decreases by 42.0%.
Confirmed removal is comparable to EffectErase (73/80 versus 72/80), with better reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:
表1比较了H3Remover与ProPainter [57],DiffuEraser [21],MiniMax-Remover [58],ROSE [31],以及PROVE-M上的EffectErase [7].
H3Remover领导所有六个图像/视频度量衡.
与原先的H3,PSNR相比,PSNR改进了7.151 dB,LPIPS和FVD减少了60.3%和84.7%,抽样确认的机身清除量从40/80增加到73/80.
与每公吨最佳基准相比,PSNR提高了1.395 dB,LPIPS下降了18.9%,FVD下降了42.0%.
经确认的清除与EffectErase(73/80对72/80)相似,重建质量较好。

blocks.en:
Table 2 covers 60 WIPER clips and 30 driving clips from ten scenes, equally split between KITTI-360 and Waymo.
H3Remover improves both RC metrics over original H3 on all three sets; sampled-frame confirmed removals rise from 43/60 to 60/60, 1/15 to 14/15, and 10/15 to 14/15, respectively.
It also records the lowest RC-T and highest confirmed-removal fraction on all three sets, and the highest RC-S on both driving sets.
These comparisons remain exploratory: judgment layouts differ, and driving prompts target all visible vehicles/people for both H3 variants but supplied-mask targets for competing methods.
Unknowns remain in the denominator; source videos are not clean ground truth.
blocks.zh:
表2包含60个WIPER剪辑和30个来自10个场景的驾驶剪辑,同样分为KITTI-360和Waymo.
H3Remover在所有三套中都比最初的H3改进了RC度量;抽样确认的机身清除量分别从43/60升至60/60、1/15升至14/15和10/15升至14/15。
它还记录了所有三套车中最低的RC-T和最高的确认清除分数,以及两套车中最高的RC-S.
这些比较仍然是探索性的:判断的布局不同,驱动提示针对H3两种变体的所有可见车辆/人员,但针对相互竞争的方法提供任务目标。
分母中还保留着未知的;源视频不是干净的地面真相.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows scenarios involving target remnants, shadows, reflections, and non-target structure.
The selected examples highlight object removal and background preservation behavior; the driving rows use the target scopes described above.
Compared with competing methods, H3Remover leaves fewer visible target remnants and associated effects in the illustrated cases.
The revealed regions also blend more naturally with adjacent content, with fewer conspicuous artifacts and better continuity of background textures.
Meanwhile, surrounding structures and non-target objects are better retained, illustrating a favorable balance between removal completeness and scene preservation.
blocks.zh:
图4显示了涉及目标遗留物、阴影、反射和非目标结构的情景。
所选例子突出对象移除和背景保存行为;驱动行使用上述目标范围.
与相互竞争的方法相比,H3Remover在图例中留下的可见目标残留物和相关效应较少.
所揭示的区域也更自然地与相邻内容混合,显性文物较少,背景纹理的连续性也更好.
同时,周边结构和非目标物体得到更好的保留,说明在清除完整性和现场保存之间取得了有利的平衡。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reward Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 报酬分析

blocks.en:
Table 3 compares original H3 with four adapted configurations using identical source videos, masks, prompts, and initial sampling noise at evaluation.
The full configuration improves PSNR from 22.390 to 27.869 dB and reduces LPIPS by 48.8%.
These gains demonstrate improved reconstruction quality over the pretrained editor under matched evaluation inputs.
blocks.zh:
表3比较了原始H3与四个经过改造的配置,在评价时使用了相同的源视频,口罩,提示和初始取样噪音.
全配置将PSNR从22.390改进为27.869 dB,并将LPIPS减少48.8%.
这些成果表明,在相应的评价投入下,经过预先培训的编辑的重建质量有所提高。

blocks.en:
Adding geometry to target-only training improves PSNR by 2.167 dB.
Binary RGB protection further improves PSNR and SSIM, with trade-offs in LPIPS and RC-T.
The full configuration achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and RC-T, while target-only training retains the highest RC-S.
Figure 5 illustrates complementary reward roles: target feedback encourages removal of objects retained by original H3; geometry constrains unintended deletion of non-target clocks; protected RGB feedback supports cleaner tabletop appearance with reduced refractive residue; and HPSv3 helps reduce local blur and translucent artifacts.
These examples compare complete configurations rather than isolate individual reward effects.
blocks.zh:
将几何学添加到只针对对象的训练中,使PSNR改进为2.167 dB.
二进制RGB保护进一步完善了PSNR和SSIM,在LPIPS和RC-T中进行了权衡.
完整的配置实现了最好的PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS,以及RC-T,而仅目标训练保留了最高的RC-S.
图5说明了互补的奖励作用:目标反馈鼓励移除原H3保留的物体;几何限制意外删除非目标时钟;受保护的RGB反馈支持更清洁的表顶外观,减少折射残留;HPSv3帮助减少局部模糊和半透明文物.
这些例子比较完整的配置,而不是孤立个人的奖励效果.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 summarizes training statistics.
Between updates 1–10 and 91–100, mean total reward rises from − 0.069 -0.069 to 0.238 0.238 and target-depth reward from 0.213 0.213 to 0.452 0.452 ; protected RGB error falls from 0.0286 0.0286 to 0.0151 0.0151 and background-order error from 0.0487 0.0487 to 0.0417 0.0417 .
These trends indicate stronger target-depth responses alongside improved appearance and geometric preservation.
HPSv3 feedback fluctuates without an upward trend; its intended role is a perceptual constraint that regularizes visual quality alongside task-specific rewards.
blocks.zh:
图6汇总了培训统计。
更新1-10至91-100之间,平均奖励总额从−0.069-0.69增至0.238 0.238 0.238,目标深度奖励从0.213 0.213增至0.452 0452;保护的RGB错误从0.0286 0.0286降至0.0151 0.0151,背景顺序错误从0.0487 0.0487降至0.0417 0.041 0.4017.
这些趋势表明,在改善外观和几何保存的同时,目标深度反应更加有力。
HPSv3反馈波动,没有上升趋势;它的预期作用是视觉约束,使视觉质量规范化,同时对特定任务进行奖励.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented H3Remover, a reinforcement learning framework that unlocks pretrained video editors’ object-removal capabilities without paired object-free targets during adaptation.
By combining geometry-based constraints, protected appearance preservation, and perceptual quality feedback, H3Remover encourages faithful removal while limiting unintended changes to the surrounding scene.
Experiments demonstrate clear improvements over the original H3 model, with effective removal of objects and their associated effects, plausible background reconstruction, and improved scene preservation.
Our findings highlight source-conditioned reward design as a practical approach to strengthening existing video editing capabilities without paired supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了H3Remover,这是一个强化学习框架,它解锁了预先训练的视频编辑器在适应过程中没有配对的无对象目标而去除对象的能力.
H3Remover通过结合几何学限制,保护外观保存,以及感知质量反馈,鼓励忠实清除,同时限制对周围场景的意外改变.
实验表明,与最初的H3模型相比,有明显的改进,有效清除了物体及其相关影响,进行了可信的背景重建,并改进了现场保护。
我们的调查结果强调,以源头为条件的奖励设计是加强现有视频编辑能力而不实行配对监督的实用办法。
